entities.name: Dawnsire

entities.name: Sundog
entities.description: Ship carried by Dawnsire until launched to follow Alpharael.

entities.name: Galvarinha
entities.description: Pilot of Flare Three, shot down by the Guns of Kavaron.

entities.name: Captain Slats

relations.quote: Dawnsire was built by the Sunstar Free Company .
